label.description: Shown above the time. By default the last part of the zone name.

hour12.description: 12-hour time with AM and PM instead of 24-hour time.

now.description:
Show this time instead of the current one, written as
`2026-10-27T14:05:00Z` or `2026-10-27T19:35:00+05:30` (years 1970 to
2999). For tests and demos.

seconds.description: Show seconds too (the tile then refreshes every second).

zones.description:
The time zones to show, in order: IANA names such as `Europe/Berlin`
or `UTC`, or `local` for this machine's zone. An entry can also be
`{ zone, label }` to name the stat.

entries.description: The local time in one or more time zones, as a row of stats. Uses the system's time zone database; no network.
entries.name: Clock
